description: Standing in the center of the walled courtyard is a masterfully crafted water fountain created in the image of a sea kraken.  Wrapped in the kraken's tentacles is a flawless crown-of-Charl shell, from which the water cascades into the base of the fountain.  Well-kept flowerbeds containing an assortment of exotic flowers have been bordered with a collection of ruby-lined nassa shells, along with yellow, pink, and blue coquina shells.  An opal-flecked walkway leads up to a set of double doors.
title: [Kraken Manor, Courtyard]
4583.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An elegant stairway dominates this spacious foyer as it curves round and round leading up to the second floor.  Suspended from the balustrade above is a dark green silk banner that has been embroidered with the words, "Welcome One And All," in gold thread.  Polished to a shine, the speckled marble floor is uncluttered, save for an elaborately made coat rack with carved seashells.

4584.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Underfoot, plush ivory-colored carpet spreads from wall to wall, and dozens of ornate mirrors hang on the deep blue watersilk walls.  The corners on each of the mirror frames have been inlaid with silvery conch shells.  Underneath each mirror stand tables with gilded edges, each bearing transparent quartz vases with a bouquet of blood-red roses.

title: [Kraken Manor, Hall of Mirrors]

description: Three steps lead up to the platform of a raised dais, where a massive rectangular-shaped oak table rests.  Intricately carved chairs covered in blue velvet surround the table. 4586.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A considerable-sized, oval-shaped, lacquered table with matching chairs dominates the center of the room.  Standing in the middle of the table is a fair-sized jade and gold vase that is overflowing with purple monkey flowers.  A roaring fire blazes within the fireplace, casting deep shadows along the walls and marble floor.  Built-in bookcases are filled with dusty leather-bound tomes.
title: [Kraken Manor, Library]
4587.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Clustered together in several small circles are high-backed leather armchairs.  Nestled in the center of each group of chairs are tables, which are constructed from black willow and trimmed in rhimar metal.  Delicate wisps of cigar smoke drift lazily in the air as its sweet, pungent scent fills the room.  Heavy brocatelle curtains completely block the bay window behind.
title: [Kraken Manor, Parlour]
4588.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The breeze coming from the open window does little to alleviate the heat in this room.  Hanging on the walls by the hearth is an assortment of copper pots and stoneware.  Spread out over a wooden cutting table are various spoons, knives, and forks with long wooden handles used in the daily preparation of the meals.  A trail of spilled flour leads toward the partially opened door of the pantry.  At the far end of the kitchen, a darkened doorway leading down to the wine cellar stands wide open.
title: [Kraken Manor, Kitchen]
4589.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Racks of clay bottle-holders take up most of the floor space in this spacious and well-lit wine cellar.  Nestled in their own individual cradles, touching nothing but their supports are bottles of wine, made from the nearby vineyards.  Polished oak paneling covers the stone walls and the natural knots in the paneling resemble eyes.  In one corner of the room, a tall wood cabinet with stained glass is pushed up against the wall, its door stands slightly ajar.
title: [Kraken Manor, Wine Cellar]
4590.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Reeking of hot metal and smoke, the chamber centers around a tremendous steel-cased crucible reigning over a circular center island.  Molten metal surrounds the isle, pooling in an enormous basin.  Floor stones surrounding the lake of protometal are cracked and blistered, their centers incised with a hammer and anvil device.
title: [Subterrain, Crucible]

description: The cool, muted hues of a mural frame the warped mass of a twisted veil iron altar perched at the sloping corridor's end.  Low-burning torches cast sullen light on the narrow carpeted path leading to the altar.  The walls to either side are formed of rugged, unfinished rock.

The trees are stunted little things, whipped at all times by the sere desert wind, but their shadows are cool and deep and welcoming.

Sand gives way to richer earth near the moon-silvered verges of the water, which begins not far from the base of a long ramp of hard-packed sand.  The trees are stunted little things, whipped by the icy night wind, but their shadows stretch long and black across the water.

The life-giving pond waits down a long ramp of hard-packed sand worn away by the passage of many feet.

description: Surrounding you is the apotheosis of all deserts, a wildly shifting sea of sands that swirl in pools of tawny and ruddy hue.  Sunlight pounds down from an open sky that is as blue as a jewel, reflecting in rippling waves off of the superheated grit.  Winds sweep down in stinging waves, blowing golden veils before them.

Surrounding you is the apotheosis of all deserts, a wildly shifting sea of sands that swirl in pools of silver and shadow beneath the starlit sky. description: Whipped by the winds and punished by sunlight as hot as a forge-fire, the dunes are in constant motion, tossed as if waves on an actual sea. description: The prickly tips of a saguaro's arm peeks out of a nearby dune, though there is no indication whether it is merely a disembodied limb or a helpless cactus buried whole. description: The dark night air presses in all around you.  Dense clouds of fireflies float about the woods, littering them with pockets of flashing light and making it more difficult to get your bearings.

You wander deeper into the dark woods then stop.  The area you've wandered into is completely devoid of light.  Looking down, you find that you can barely make out your own form.  Even the fireflies that seem to swarm in the rest of the woods are nowhere to be found.

Roots threaten to send you sprawling to the ground as you stumble about in the dark.  Clouds of fireflies taunt you with light, but never give enough to see anything by, let alone the trail you're looking for.  An owl hoots in the distance, then the woods are deathly silent again.

A light breeze moves through the trees, bringing a welcome change to the still, unending darkness.  The trees are widely spaced in this part of the woods, which does nothing to help in finding the trail.  A startled squirrel races across your path, and then the woods are still again.

A solitary shaft of moonlight breaks through the foliage above, almost blinding you with its brightness.  A look around in the unexpected light reveals that you are in a small clearing.  Searching about the clearing turns up no sign of the trail continuing.  A lone firefly dances into the clearing, zipping in front of your face a few times as if mocking you, before disappearing into the dark woods.

The sound of a stream fills your ears as you wander about in the dark.  You continue making your way through the trees, swatting away the occasional firefly, when you suddenly find the stream.  You shake off your now-soaked foot and mutter to yourself as you continue searching for the trail.

Thin rays of moonlight stab through the darkness.  In the light they provide you can make out signs that others have been here before.  Peering closer to examine the footsteps, you blink as you recognize your own footprints going off in several different directions.

Fireflies zip about in the chill night air, small motes of light that do nothing to help you see where you are.  Peering about you can't even tell which way you came from.  The dark forest presses in about you, deathly silent and foreboding.

Dead leaves rustle and twigs snap as you plod on through the darkness.  Occasional clouds of fireflies flicker by further off in the woods like passing torches.  A fallen branch laying across your path almost trips you and it almost seems the light will never come again.

A cold, damp fog presses in all about you.  Barely able to see your own nose, you quickly lose your sense of direction.  Looking at the forest about you tells you nothing, as every tree looks like the last one you peered at.

description: It appears that the inhabitants of the warren were attempting to create another tunnel, but a huge chunk of stone clearly ended any attempts to dig further.  The surface of the partially buried boulder glitters in the dim light from numerous crystalline growths covering its surface.
title: [Warrens]
5669.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A few simple baskets filled with an assortment of nuts and dried fruits are resting near a large flattened stone.  A fine ivory dust covers the surface of the rock, and it looks as if it might be used for food preparation.  A small alcove dug into the wall holds several clay bowls, each containing a thick unidentifiable paste.  A stack of large broad leaves is also stored within this alcove, their purpose unknown.
title: [Warrens]
5670.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A massive gaping hole along one wall has been crudely boarded up with old planks and an assortment of twisted branches.  At the foot of this barrier lies a immense worm whose decaying form is covered with numerous puncture marks.  Several deep stains along the wall and ground, along with some tattered cloth reveal that the oversized bug did not go out quietly.
title: [Warrens]
5671.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A rotted monir chest has been tipped over in one corner and is completely empty of any contents.  The lock appears to have been smashed open by the force of some blunt object and whatever valuables this box might have contained are long gone.
title: [Warrens]
5672.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A massive piece of slate has been propped up so that it leans against one wall, the surface of the stone completely covered with glyphs.  Crude wax candles have been placed in a perfect semi-circle about this tablet and a few of them show signs of having been lit recently.
title: [Warrens]
5673.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: All sounds, save the footfalls of travelers, fall away along this dark stretch of path.  The end of a rope dangles out of reach, suspended from the branch of a tall oak tree here.  The rope is very thick, and has been cut clean through at the end.
title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
5674.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A pool of black water collects here at the low point of this huge valley.  All around, hills rise leading out of this area.  The path is somewhat flat to the north, but a steep incline rises to the south.
title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
5675.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A huge, flat rock here provides a good place to rest from the slipping and sliding required to travel this section of path along this steep incline.  The path ascends to the southeast, and descends to the north.
title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
5676.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shredded scrolls have been scattered about like a heavy snowfall, piling against the walls in drifts and fluttering in the breeze that comes in from the east.  The walls themselves waver in the wind, pressed and pulled by the trees outside.  While interesting to look at, the instability hardly inspires confidence in the remaining lifespan of the architecture.
title: [Deep Woods, Ruined Temple]
5697.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Golden glass covers everything, creating the illusion of inclusions in amber.  Beneath the glimmering surface are books, scrolls and other containers for knowledge, trapped for all time by the razored shards.  A large branch grows through the hole where the window once sat, raining pine needles down over the room.
title: [Deep Woods, Ruined Temple]
5698.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A block of grey stone is half buried in the soft earth, set in a crater as if it had fallen from some height.  To the east another part of the wall it fell from still stands, riddled with breaks and crevices.  The fog curls back from the structure's surface, as if loathe to touch the ruined building.
title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
5699.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A dense copse of trees stands to the southeast, nearly impassable but not quite.  Beneath a fine layer of dark dirt is river sand, peppered with polished stones and the dried corpses of water plants.
title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
5700.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A huge patch of toadstools once stood here, in the shadow of the small hillock to the southwest.  Some creature has knocked them all down, however, crushing them into the soft dirt in a fit of pique.  Claw marks scar the trees, scabbed over by bits of crusty yellow sap.
title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
5701.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Silence hangs heavy in the air, as if all of nature held its breath.  Even the mists are still, stagnating around the thorny plants and sky-reaching pines.  A current of tension coils about the trees, as if two great but unseen armies watched each other across a wooded battleground, merely waiting for the general's signal before exploding into violence.
title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
5702.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The corpse of some small mammal lies mangled on the soft earth.  The body is oddly dessicated, and seems to have decayed one part at a time, instead of all at once.  The fur, once soft and plush, is rough and dry, as if all moisture and essence had been pulled forcibly from it.
title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
5703.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Something with sharp claws has wounded one of the trees, ripping the protective bark from the tree's grainy flesh.  From the gashes pours thick amber sap, running down the trunk as if the tree bled.  Several insects have been trapped in the substance, sacrificing themselves as fascinating pieces of amber in the making.
title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
5704.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An immense branch lies broken on the ground.  Through the hole in the canopy of trees its fall created shines sunlight, perhaps the only patch of it in the entire forest.  Its warmth dispells the cool mist, and small white flowers grow from the rich brown earth, basking in the light.
title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
5705.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bramble bushes and tall pine trees pull stone from the ruined temple to the north, as if seeking to tear it down.  Fog swirls about, curling up the treetrunks and hissing softly through the underbrush but refusing to touch the temple itself.
title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
5706.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The thorn bushes grow thicker to the east, shredding cloth and flesh with equal voracity.  The mighty pines fight the brush for space, leaving hardly any room to stand, let alone walk, uninjured.  Furry moss creeps up the trees, unable to find another space in which to live.
title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
5707.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Twigs and other bits of thorn bush stick out over the top of the tall fogbank, giving you almost no warning as to the positions of the sharp bracken.  Trees stretch toward the unseen sky, covered in slick green moss, and a soft breeze caresses you, giving you goosebumps.
title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
5708.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The trees, brambles and fog all conspire to lose you within the forest, making visibility uncertain at best.  Any movement becomes a shambling stagger, more controlled tripping than a true walk as the bushes seem to reach out to purposely snare you.  Brambles obscure a crumbling section of the temple wall.
title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
5709.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The burned-out remains of a small house stand on the west side of the path here.  Remains of door hinges and latches can be seen in the ashes, but almost all of the wood that once made up the house has been burned away.  Curiously, the pine and fir trees nearby show no signs of having been burned.
title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
12993.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The breaking of twigs and scurrying of small animals can be heard but not seen on the valley floor, which is covered with a thick, unmoving fog.  The crashing waves of the shore are now far off and cannot be heard, but the smell of salt air is still noticeable through the strong scent of pine.
title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
12996.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Many fallen trees cross the path here, and occasional snakes can be seen writhing and working their way between the fallen pines.  The air is nearly completely still, and muffled footfalls disturb the forest life which warily watches the path.
title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
12998.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large, broken pine stands here, creaking loudly in the occasional breeze that blows high overhead.  The pine was apparently struck by lightning long ago, as the bark is scorched and the tree is split clean through to the root.  Many eyes watch from the forest, the observers taking special care not to be noticed.
title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
12999.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A tree stand is situated just off the path here, providing comfortable temporary lodging for hunters who frequent these woods.  The broken tips of many arrows litter this area, and the trees nearby bear the dark bloodstains of many gutted game animals.  Empty, broken flasks litter a small ring of stones used to contain fires lit in the tree stand.
title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
13000.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A blasted mound of earth occupies the center of the path here, and many travelers have worn paths around both sides of the mound.  The earth has been disturbed by something erupting through the surface, something large and strong.  Small boulders lie around the mound, as if casually tossed aside.
title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
13001.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A hillock of grape vines stands just off the south side of the path here.  Thousands of bees and flies circle busily, feeding on the thousands of fermenting grapes.  Grape vines snake through the bushes and climb the trees.
title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
13002.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The path takes a sharp bend here, ascending toward the coast and descending into a deep pine-filled valley.  The valley is cold and a thick fog gathers over the forest floor, secluding the thick pine needle carpet from view.  A chill is in the air, and the cold is accentuated by the dampness.
title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
13003.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The hollowed-out stump of a huge, ancient pine tree pokes through the top of the layer of fog covering the ground here.  Inside the stump, wood pulp provides sustenance to a variety of mushrooms and thousands of insects burrow busily through the decaying wood.  The ground near the stump is soft, indicating that the roots of the once-magnificent tree are also decaying away.
title: [Vornavian Coast, Pine Forest]
13004.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Large mushrooms cover the ground in a miniature forest, as if mimicking the pine trees above them.  Their skin is soft and spongy, covered in a thin layer of clear slime created by the low fog.  Several have been toppled by the careless movements of someone or something, exposing the fluted surface beneath the cap.
title: [Deep Woods, Overgrowth]
13005.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The twin towering arched wrought iron gates give way to a uniform crushed shell path bordered on either side by overgrown black rose hedges and beds of red-gold sirenflowers, mingled throughout by ever-creeping vines of wisteria.  The path is circular along the iron fence, splitting sharply in towards the thicket in precise locations, marked by five tall alabaster pillars.  Converging at the center, the hedgerow paths form a pentagram encircling a clearing in which stands a black marble sanitarium, its seamless walls glowing in the moonlight.

description: At one time a doctor's office, the room is in a state of chaotic disarray save for an obsessively organized oak desk centered in the room.  The desk is flanked on opposite walls by a lopsided corkboard and wide bay windows so caked in filth that moonlight barely penetrates them.  A tall slanted bookshelf spans another wall, its staggered shelves displaying various oddities.  The floor is covered in deliberately carved markings, concentrated near an oddly upholstered couch.  Hanging overhead is a swirling black void spanning the ceiling.

description: A dramatic room of dark burgundy bourde with golden accents, the parlour conveys a measure of classical Faendryl elegance contrasting with its idiosyncratic accents.  Centered across from the circular hallway is a sharply chiseled obsidian fireplace, its hearth formed of shallow steps leading to a distorted rift within.  Plush, heavy drapes nearly conceal the old iron bars across the moonlit arched windows of the room, while just above the fireplace hangs an odd oil painting.  Matching claw-footed bourde armchairs and a glass table are centered in the room.

Nothing but darkness can be seen at any angle, and the incessant crashing of waves against the rocky shore reverberates through the night. description: What may once have been a fine house now lies hollow and guttered.  All that is left standing is the rickety skeleton of the structure, heavily blackened with char in some areas.  A mixture of dust, dead leaves, and decaying pieces of wood form the debris that nearly covers the floor.
title: [Abandoned Manor, Remains]
31084.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dust hangs heavily in the air, lending it a musty scent tinged with ash.  The western end of the tunnel terminates in a rough rockface, while more smoothly hewn stone walls extend away from it in the opposite direction.  Inset into the ceiling is a wooden trapdoor with no visible means of opening.
title: [Dusty Tunnel]
31085.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A faint breeze drifts in from the tunnel mouth, bringing with it a fresh scent and helping to dispel any lingering must in the air.  What began as a few patches on the rocky ground slowly turns into a packed dirt fully covering it.  A large opening stands at the far end of the tunnel leading to the outside.
title: [Dusty Tunnel]
31086.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A grass-covered knoll rises up to the west with a dark tunnel leading into its interior.  Thick bushes cover the ground, growing wild in both shape and direction.  Extending out from the hillside is a rough dirt path which cuts through the shrubbery with a series of hearty weeds taking hold along its route.
title: [Overgrown Ruins, Trail]
31087.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Meandering through the thickly grown bushes and grasses, the path crosses a small dilapidated bridge over a weed-filled creek.  Now dry, the creek bed has been covered with many tall grasses, while some flowering bushes have encroached down from the former banks.  The dirt of the path becomes more packed as it continues north.
title: [Overgrown Ruins, Path]
31088.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The dirt footpath forks towards both the northwest and northeast, and gives way from packed earth to a mix of smooth stones and ragged grass springing from the ground.  Running alongside the path is a low cracked stone wall, with numerous stones laying fallen along its base.  A series of weeds entangle those stones, while some thicker vines cling to their surfaces.
title: [Overgrown Ruins, Path]
31089.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several tall trees line one side of the path, with their thick swollen roots breaking through cobblestones.  At the convergence of the three pathways sits a tall narrow tree ringed with large rocks.  A series of flowering bushes have grown rampant across from the trees, making it hard to tell where one bush ends and the next begins.
title: [Overgrown Ruins, Path]
31090.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Composed almost completely of cobblestones and only a few patches of exposed dirt, the path becomes more well defined as it continues northward.  To the west a large hedge rises up high above the ground, its encroachment east seemingly kept in check by the tightly packed stones of the pathway.  One section of the hedge is less verdant than the others, though, and bears clear signs of fire damage.
title: [Overgrown Ruins, Hedge]
31091.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rough dirt is all that makes up the path here, with a jumble of mud-covered stones off to the side the evidence of a mudslide at some point in the past.  A fallen tree lies atop a misshapen swath of earth, heavy with rot and various forms of brightly colored fungus.
title: [Overgrown Ruins, Path]
31092.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A veritable wall of thorns and greenery form a massive patch of bramble to the west.  Growths and sprouts creep up from the dirt and mud of the path and dislodge some of its few remaining stones.  Looming above and beyond the bramble is a thick canopy of trees and the forest they belong to.
title: [Overgrown Ruins, Path]
31093.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Four stone paths converge into a large stone-paved open space broken up by the shattered and crumbled remains of several columns standing in the middle.  Three are nothing more than weathered stone bases, but one column remains partially intact.  Each column stands at a right angle to its neighbors to form a rectangular shape.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest
title: [Overgrown Ruins, Columns]
31094.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The path ends here in a circle around a raised circular pool, its walls made from the same cobblestones underfoot.  Filled with heavily brackish water, the surface of the pool is further marred by large growths of fungus.  A series of cracked stone steps lead up to a decrepit gazebo that overlooks the water.
title: [Overgrown Ruins, Pool]
31095.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Once large in size, the gazebo is only a shell of its former self as a fallen tree has destroyed the rear half of the structure.  The remaining wood planks make the footing treacherous due to the trauma from the tree and passage of time.  The stone steps remain mostly intact, but still bear numerous cracks across their surface.
title: [Overgrown Ruins, Gazebo]
31096.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The path bends here around a wide low stump, while the cobblestones grow more sparse and missing as it continues to the west.  Old roots from the stump are visible, causing the ground to lay uneven.  Thick bushes grow along the path, their mix of leaves, vines, and thorns entwined in a dangerous tangle.
title: [Overgrown Ruins, Path]
31097.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The thick bramble surrounds and extends across the roughly cut path.  Thick, sharp thorns cover the branches and vines that lay in every direction.  Despite having been cut back, the bramble gives the impression of only being temporarily pushed back.
title: [Overgrown Ruins, Bramble]
31098.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stone path widens into a wide cobblestone square atop this short bluff overlooking an expansive overgrown vineyard.  Though no longer capable of offering seating, a series of broken stone benches stand sentinel over the area.  The remnants of a once large lattice hang overhead, some portions having rotted away completely, while others still hold dried-out and long-dead grapevines.
title: [Overgrown Ruins, Overlook]
31099.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Large cobblestones lie mostly embedded in the soft soil underfoot, but still manage to provide enough stability to traverse.  To the north, a small trail winds through what remains of a rose garden, and to the west there are rows upon rows of overgrown grapevines.  The sour scent of rotting fruit wafts through on a slight, sullen breeze.
title: [Derelict Vineyard, Divergence]
31100.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The trail continues through the garden, though wildly overgrown rose bushes encroach drastically in spots, their thorns poised to rend whatever they come into contact with.  The unmistakeable scent of roses suffuses the area, but it is tainted by the hint of rotting vegetation in the damp areas beneath the bushes themselves.
title: [Derelict Vineyard, Rose Garden]
31101.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A particularly robust rose bush has spread to cover the trail entirely in this area, its flowers heavy with condensation and the sheer length of each stem.  The earth underfoot is marshy, with stagnant pools of brackish moisture dotting the area.  Weeds are thick in the area outside the path, their thistles and thorns poised to grab at any fabric or flesh that brushes against them.
title: [Derelict Vineyard, Rose Garden]
31102.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The trail terminates here at a badly scorched rose bush.  Nearly three-quarters of the foliage has been burnt away, and the roots on one side are completely exposed.  The remaining roses are a crimson hue, but their beauty serves only as a jarring counterpoint to the extreme damage visible across the rest of the bush.  A wide furrow of earth has been dug out, as well, in the area just around the heart of the damage, the exposed earth likewise blackened from extreme heat.
title: [Derelict Vineyard, Rose Garden]
31103.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ground underfoot is largely overgrown, though a slick game trail winds its way north along the rotting grape trellises.  In this area, the trellises are largely intact, though the vines wound around them have long since died, hanging loosely in limp disarray.  Here and there, a single grape can be glimpsed, itself half-covered in rot and hanging on by the thinnest of threads.
title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
31104.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The nearest trellises on either side of the path have all but collapsed, with most of the crossbars missing entirely.  The posts still remain, and the undergrowth has sprung up all around them, creating an impenetrable semi-natural barrier.  The trail continues through this area, largely unmarred save for the occasional presence of an odd-shaped footprint.
title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
31105.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The remains of a campfire lie in the middle of the trail, and the undergrowth seems to have been cut back to a degree.  The small pit that holds the charred branches has weeds sprouting from its heart, testimony to the fact that this site hasn't been used in a long while.  The trellises in this area are intact and scoured clean, with no evidence of any vines.
title: [Derelict Vineyard, Row]
31106.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: One of the trellises has fallen across the trail, and now lies half-buried in the swampy earth underfoot.  The trail shows evidence of several heavy footprints, though their edges are far from clear, making it hard to discern their source.  A dead oak tree stands opposite the trail from the trellis, its bare, splintered branches overhanging the area entirely.

description: Yew saplings crisply define the exterior edges of the path here. description: The somber entranceway is poorly lit, leaving large shadows to consume the room corners. description: The great hall of the temple vaults about your head.  The soft shuffle of feet whisper gentle prayers to the gods. description: The passage here ascends slowly, hugging the interior walls.  The whole hall has been decorated in a continuous fresco.  The first few feet are nothing but blackness, but as the slope rises great hideous winged beasts emerge from the darkness.

description: The frescos have been painted by masterful hands, and surely this work could not have been completed in one artisan's lifetime. Sapphire blue knotwork twines across the perimeter of the expansive mural, its lustrous surface gleaming in the faint illumination.  Four doors, one each in verdant green, sky blue, deep blue or dark red, engraved with the faint impressions of gentle waves fill the gaps between the tall columns lining the walls and a bright light filters in from the north.
title: [Public Baths, Annex]
28484.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A wide, circular room opens up before you, its pale ivory walls reflecting the bright light cast by the numerous brass candelabras placed throughout it.  Golden shields adorned with thin looping patterns have been hung upon the twin rows of columns that mark a path to a closed door.  The same arcing designs flow across the varnished wood of the door, slightly obscured by a fine mist of water droplets that continually drip down its surface.
title: [Public Baths, Annex]
28485.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A massive golden sun is inlaid upon the ceiling, its wavy stylized flames radiating outwards in a beautiful pattern.  Droplets of water occasionally drip down from the rounded gleaming design, disappearing in a sharp hiss as they land upon a small pile of heated rocks in the center of the room.  Dark ash benches are stacked against the walls, each enshrouded by a hazy steam that pervades the chamber with its muggy heat.
title: [Steam Room]
28486.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wavy crimson-hued flames of gold encircle the perimeter of a shallow pool upon the floor, their surfaces dappled with droplets from the steam continually rising up from the waters surface.  The encroaching walls are painted in soft shades of scarlet and textured slightly to resemble the swirls of a roaring inferno.  A bench trimmed with wispy patterns of graceful design sits next to a lustrous circular mahogany table, a collection of multi-hued pots set upon it.
title: [Fiery Bath]
28487.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The surroundings are cloaked in mixed shades of light green and deep blue, only a few candles about you piercing the moody darkness settled over the area.  Water within a small pool upon the floor shifts and reflects the faint light in wavy cerulean flickers, its heat being more felt than seen amidst the rich hues of the room.  The warm glow of the candles causes a collection of pots resting upon a small table to glint softly as the tiny flames rise and fall continuously.
title: [Oceanic Bath]
28488.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Walls painted in muted shades of white and blue surround you, imparting the feeling of the expansive outdoors within the sparse confines of the room.  Steam rises in languid wisps from a small circular pool within the center of the room, the slight haze obscuring the puffy, swirling clouds rendered upon the ceiling.  A small pale white bench sits near the eastern wall, a table draped with a covering of the same hue positioned directly next to it.
title: [Sky Bath]
28489.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dark green ivy has been painted along the edges of the pure white walls, twining about each other in a gentle embrace upon the low ceiling.  A small pool bubbling with wisps of steam is set in the middle of the room, and a small wooden bench padded with verdant green leather is propped up against the wall next to it.  Rich, celadon-hued velvet drapes across a small russet wooden table, and a few pots filled with dark oils rest atop it.
title: [Ivy Bath]
28490.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gleaming silver tridents are set upon the wall, adding a touch of brightness to the swirling deep blue hue of the surrounding walls.  Many small pools are aligned in neat rows about the floor, their surfaces rippling with reflected light.  Faint wavy patterns flow along the dark tiles between the different pools, resembling the gently undulating waves of an ocean current.
title: [Cold Baths]
28491.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Serpentine gold-scaled dragons flank the sides of a large pool bubbling with heat stretching across the room.  Rearing out of the watery depths is a glittering drakes head statue, its maw open to gush forth a huge stream of steaming hot water high up into the air and back down with a splash.  Lustrous marble columns ringed with silver leaves mark the edges of the circular pool, their surfaces trailed with tiny droplets.
title: [Hot Baths]
28492.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Stretched out before you is a dimly lit modwir table topped with smooth green felt, a magnificent black drake adorning its surface.  The eyes of the beast stare straight ahead, seemingly following any movement.  Resting atop the felt is a low-burning tallow candle, as well as three bone white ivory dice.  Behind the table stands an elegantly garbed dealer, his eyes blind and vacant.  His expression remains cold while his stick flashes out to scoop up the cubes.
title: [Seamist Hall, Black Drake Table]
28594.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Surrounded by a low stone wall made of remnants from previous constructions, an oddly-shaped building is almost hidden by creeping rope-like vines adorned with verdant heart-shaped leaves.  Sunlight reflects off the blackened windows, barely visible through the thickly growing vegetation.  A canted doorframe slants at a dramatic angle, and the modwir door swings open occasionally with a slight creaking sound.  Piercing the door near its top is a small, crooked lunette.
title: [Zelia's Temple, Courtyard]
28598.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A beam of light streams through a crooked lunette carved into a slanted modwir door, creating a large half-moon shape on the grey floor tiles.  The walls mimic the tilt of the entryway, creating the discomforting sensation of falling.  A silvery glow extends up from the stone stairs that lead down and further into the temple.
title: [Zelia's Temple, Foyer]
28599.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Stone stairs start out wide and even, then become more erratic and twisting back upon themselves in hairpin turns, traversing this passageway.  Each landing created by the snaking steps features a small wooden bench, and yet walls lit with bright oil torches are devoid of any art or tapestries.  A tiny cluster of silver bells is suspended from a small hook set into one of the bench arms.
title: [Zelia's Temple, Descent]
28600.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dangling from the ceiling by a confusing array of ropes and pulleys, a half dozen harnessed clergy thrash about at various distances between the floor and the chamber's high ceiling.  In sharp contrast, a single robed figure hangs motionless among the chamber's occupants.
title: [Zelia's Temple, Journey Chamber]
28601.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: In the chamber's center, a large stone sculpture is suspended parallel to the floor and about four feet above it.  The statue depicts a humanoid female clutching at the hem of her tunic, bringing it up to hide her face.  The smooth curves of her bared legs and the folds of her garment are still unmarred, but her head and upper torso have been disfigured and reduced to hammered stone.  Squatting beneath the statue, a pair of elven gentlemen wearing false beards and loincloths hammer busily at its bosom.
title: [Zelia's Temple, Anteroom]
28602.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Entering this typical confessional proves to be anything but normal, as when the door closes, the far panel slides aside to reveal another small room.  A mix of voices can faintly be heard, melding together in a confusing murmur.
title: [Zelia's Temple, Confessional]
28603.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This semi-circular room at the east side of the temple features a large silver crescent moon inlaid upon a floor of black marble edged with white alabaster.  A fresco of an ocean teaming with wildlife has been richly painted upon the ceiling, yet the walls feature a cloud-filled sunny sky.  Compounding the topsy-turvy distortion, moisture overhead falls in occasional large drops, seeping from some hidden underground water source.
title: [Zelia's Temple, Apse]
28604.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Six stalls line the walls here, and feature a misericord in each small open-fronted enclosure.  Several are occupied by preaching clergy, their sermons alternately overrunning each other as they rise shrill with delusion or sink quietly into stammered muttering.  The cacophony completely overwhelms the harpsichord being played in the background by a gossamer-robed giantwoman, whose lips curl in a lunatic grin.
title: [Zelia's Temple, Oratory]
28605.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Armed with a large butcher knife, a priest meticulously spreads what appears to be cockroach marmalade on a thick slice of bread.  Completing the task, he picks up the piece of bread and flings it across the room against the far wall!  The bread sticks to the wall for a moment before sliding down to the floor to join the slumped forms of its predecessors, where a sizable crowd of live cockroaches appear to be helping themselves to the gratuitous feast.
title: [Zelia's Temple, Refectory]
28606.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Worshipers and clergy pass through this barrel-vaulted chamber on their way in and out of the temple.  Interwoven with metallic threads, the clergy's pale golden robes appear to almost glow even in the shadows of the entryway.
title: [Temple of Phoen, Entry]
28607.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shafts of sunlight spear through the glaes dome, warming the smooth matte of clay tiles set into the floor of this vast chamber.  Hand painted with soft muted colors, the tiles are patterned to mirror the cerulean blue sky above on a clear day.  A whirl of pale white streaks across the surface of the tiles, barely clouding the glorious gold of the sun, adding the final touch to the celestial mosaic.  Brightly lit halls fork from the side of the chamber, leading further into the majestic temple.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest
title: [The Divine Sun]
28608.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rivers of watered silk cascade over the walls in lavish tapestries.  Long-forgotten tales of history and lore unravel throughout the beautiful hangings, in delicate weavings of fine gold thread.  Relics bejeweled with blue sapphires and lapis are set in front of the tapestries, as homage to those woven into the draping silks.  Lancing across the halls, dazzling glares of light are reflected and guided by a cleverly positioned mirror on the western wall.
title: [The Divine Sun, Hall]
28609.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An antique mirror, framed in gold filigree, graces the entire length of the eastern wall in this corridor.  Light streams in from above and dances across the reflective surface of the mirror, casting beams of light toward the center of the temple.  Ceramic urns lining the walls are painted in the earthy hues of amber, brown, and russet.  A brilliant display of yellow sunflowers in full bloom fills the glossy urns, and perfumes the warm, breezy air with their distinctive fragrance.
title: [The Divine Sun, Hall]
28610.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The temple's facetted glaes cap arches overhead, supported by sandstone pillars.  Deeply carved with designs of winged pegasi, the imagery on the pillars depicts these mystical creatures in flight towards the clear, sky lit ceiling.  Light focused by the lens is absorbed into a crystal orb and reflected outward in a radiant sunburst of gold that suffuses the entire chamber.  Frothy waters, flowing into an ornate bronze fount, gently caress and uplift the brilliant orb with their white-capped waves.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west
title: [The Divine Sun, Center Chamber]
28611.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Summer-graced foliage from brass laurel trees surrounds the rotunda, eclipsing it in a cool shade.  Dominating the rotunda with its elevated structure is a high dais, with a handsome statue resting upon it.  Handwoven rugs of a grassy green are spread at the foot of the dais, allowing worshippers to pray in comfort.  As wind breezes through the hollow forest, lilting and flute-like tones blend into a harmonious melody with the soft chiming of swaying honey beryl leaves.
title: [The Divine Sun, Rotunda]
28612.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Embraced by the mirror-image ascents of two curved stairways, the antechamber is a relic of good taste tarnished by the cruelties of time and abandonment.  The floor is a checkerboard of white and black tiles, though age has riddled both hues with impurities and the stones with spidering cracks.  A tiered golden corona lies, bent and warped, in the shadow of the upper balcony.  Light filtering through mud-caked windows breathes prismatic life into shards of crystal scattered over the tiles.
title: [Chapel of the Twins, Entry]
28613.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The passage of time has eaten away at the finish of a pair of scarred double doors, revealing silvery, splintered wood beneath.  Framed by the curve of a wrought iron banister, the balcony is bare of adornments, but echoes of rich hue and make in the carpeting allude to past finery.  The balcony overlooks an antechamber with a checkerboard floor of black and white marble that is in comparable disrepair.  Each descending stairway is crumbling and caked in dust.
title: [Chapel of the Twins, Overlook]
28614.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shrouds of violet-tinged ebon velvet hang from the ceiling, blocking out the feeble luminescence filtering through indigo stained glass windows along the western wall.  A chill permeates the air, though no breeze stirs the dense draperies.  Grey gauze cloaks an austere ash altar like curtains of moonlight.  Blazing from a caged sconce of dark silver mournbloom vines, a violet flame casts feeble radiance over a dark tapestry spread across the wall behind the altar.
title: [Chapel, Chantry of Grief's Wake]
28615.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To either side of the entry arch, the flames of twin candles flicker softly through a pair of translucent red glaes honeycombs to bathe the room in gentle carmine light.  Sounds are muted by the plush carpeting, whose sunny shade complements silk-slashed velvet drapes enshrouding a bower of monir heartwood.  Within, its snowy edges undimmed by the shadows in which it rests, resides a smooth rosewood altar that is partially draped in golden satin.  A vast and intricate tapestry spans the ceiling from wall to wall.
title: [Chapel, Chantry of Blessed Sins]
28616.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: There are deep grooves in the floor boards where the heavy wooden chairs have been dragged back and forth through the years. title: [Tipsy Turtle Table]
28686.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

28687.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas
